# Objectives 

To assess the validity of primary and hospital care resource use and costs estimated based on OMOP-mapped CPRD data against its corresponding source data using a cohort of women with postmenopausal fragility fractures in the UK.

The cohort of interest is made of women aged >50 years with an incident fragility fracture in any site except the face, skull or digits and no history of fracture in the two years prior. The outcomes of interest are *primary* and *secondary healthcare resource utilisation* and *direct costs* associated to first incident fracture measured during the 730 days post index date or until a censoring event occurs and expressed as values per person/year. A detailed analysis plan for this study is available here.

This RMarkdown reports the data preparation and results for the analysis conducted on the *source CPRD-HES* dataset. 

# Data Preparation

The attrition table below shows the steps we followed to clean and prepare the data for the analysis.

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(here)
library(rio)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(gt)
library(rvest)
library(DT)
library(png)
library(grid)
```


```{r}
attrition_report <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "AttritionReportCoh_Raw.xlsx"))


attrition_report %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Attrition table**")
  ) %>%
  #opt_all_caps() %>% 
    tab_options(
      # table.width = px(600),
      #heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
      heading.align = "left",
      #table.font.names = "Times New Roman",
      table.font.size = px(14)
    ) |> 
  opt_stylize(style = 3) 
```

## Primary care {.tabset}

### Healthcare resource utilisation (HCRU)

```{r}
all_summary_statistics_rp <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Output_visits_Raw.xlsx"), sheet = "all_summary_statistics")

all_summary_statistics_rp %>% 
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**All Patients - Visits per patient per year**"),
    subtitle = md("*Users and non-users*")
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>% 
    tab_options(
      table.width = px(800),
      #heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
      heading.align = "left",
      #table.font.names = "Times New Roman"
      table.font.size = px(14)
    ) |> 
  opt_stylize(style = 3) %>% 
  cols_label(
    mean_visit_per_year = "Mean",
    min_visit_per_year = "Minimum",
    max_visit_per_year = "Maximum",
    sd_visit_per_year = "SD",
    median_visit_per_year = "Median",
    lower_q_visits_per_year = "Lower Quartile",
    upper_q_visits_per_year = "Upper Quartile"
  )
```

```{r}
user_only_summary_statistics_rp <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Output_visits_Raw.xlsx"), sheet = "user_only_summary_statistics")

user_only_summary_statistics_rp %>% 
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Service users - Visits per patient per year**"),
    subtitle = md("*Subjects with >=1 visit with a clinically relevant healthcare provider*")
  ) %>%
  opt_all_caps() %>% 
    tab_options(
      table.width = px(800),
      #heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
      heading.align = "left",
      #table.font.names = "Times New Roman"
      table.font.size = px(14)
    ) |> 
  opt_stylize(style = 3) %>% 
  cols_label(
    mean_visit_per_year = "Mean",
    min_visit_per_year = "Minimum",
    max_visit_per_year = "Maximum",
    sd_visit_per_year = "SD ",
    median_visit_per_year = "Median ",
    lower_q_visits_per_year = "Lower Quartile",
    upper_q_visits_per_year = "Upper Quartile"
  )
```

### HCRU Figures

Figure 1: Total number of primary care consultations

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
Plots_Total_Visits_Raw <- readPNG(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Plots", "Tot_visits.PNG"))
grid.raster(Plots_Total_Visits_Raw)
```

Figure 2: Mean number of primary care consultations by provider specialty

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
Mean_visits_per_specialty_unweighted_raw <- readPNG(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Plots", "Mean_visits_per_specialty_unweighted.PNG"))
grid.raster(Mean_visits_per_specialty_unweighted_raw)
```

Figure 3: Exposure-weighted mean number of primary care consultations by provider specialty

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
Mean_visits_per_specialty_weighted_raw <- readPNG(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Plots", "Mean_visits_per_specialty_weighted.PNG"))
grid.raster(Mean_visits_per_specialty_weighted_raw)
```

Summary statistics of visits by specialty

```{r}
user_only_summary_rp <- import(here("CPRD Raw Analysis", "Results", "Output_visits_Raw.xlsx"), sheet = "user_only_summary")
```


```{r}
colnames(user_only_summary_rp) <- c("Specialty", "Total visits", "Mean visits per year", "SD visits per year", "Minimum visits per year", "Maximum visits per year", "Number of subjects")

# datatable(user_only_summary_rp,
#     rownames = FALSE, 
#     filter = 'top', 
#     options = list(
#         scrollX = TRUE,  # Allow user to scroll wide tables horizontally
#         search = list(regex = FALSE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
#         autoWidth = TRUE,  # Automatically adjust column widths
#         columnDefs = list(
#           list(targets = c(0, 1, 2), width = "120px"),  # Narrow columns
#             list(targets = c(3, 4), width = "300px", className = "text-wrap"), # Wider columns
#             list(
#                 targets = "_all",  # Apply to all columns
#                 className = "dt-center"  # Center align all columns
#             )
#         )
#     )
# )

datatable(user_only_summary_rp,
    rownames = FALSE, 
    filter = 'top', 
    options = list(
        scrollX = TRUE,  # Allow user to scroll wide tables horizontally
        search = list(regex = FALSE, caseInsensitive = TRUE),
        autoWidth = TRUE,  # Automatically adjust column widths
        columnDefs = list(
          list(targets = c(0, 1, 2), width = "120px"),  # Narrow columns
            list(targets = c(3, 4), width = "300px", className = "text-wrap"), # Wider columns
            list(
                targets = "_all",  # Apply to all columns
                className = "dt-center"  # Center align all columns
            )
        ),
        initComplete = JS(
            "function(settings, json) {",
            "$(this.api().table().body()).css({'font-family': 'Times New Roman', 'font-size': '16px'});",
            "}"
        )
    )
)
```
